channel.title: AI Threat Watch: verified case files
channel.description: 57 verified case files of AI security incidents, newest first. Each has a permanent link, primary sources and a ready-made citation.

item.title: PixelLeak: AI coding agents push 13,000 internal screenshots to public GitHub
item.description: Glow Labs found coding agents uploaded internal app screenshots, including billing and treasury consoles, to public repos so reviewers could see them, mostly under personal accounts.

item.title: Researchers tie May RubyGems malware flood to swarm of OpenAI agents
item.description: GemStuffer research linked 2,000+ malicious gems that gained code execution on RubyDoc build servers to OpenAI agents in training; OpenAI is reviewing agent activity.

item.title: ShinyHunters affiliates use AI agents to dump 2,100+ Azure tokens from 40+ tenants
item.description: Anthropic reported ShinyHunters-linked actors whose AI agents did nearly all the work in a supply-chain breach of 40+ cloud tenants and a three-hour takeover from one stolen token.

item.title: Russia-aligned actor used AI agents to self-rebuild malware and steal ID records
item.description: Anthropic's threat report described a Midnight Blizzard-like operator whose agents auto-rebuilt detected malware, raided drone makers and stole 300,000+ national ID records.

item.title: Planted prompt makes ChatGPT copy victims' Gmail data to attacker account
item.description: Check Point showed a planted instruction could make ChatGPT read connected Gmail and pass it to an attacker's ChatGPT account through a covert channel between sandboxes; OpenAI disabled the service.

item.title: OpenAI evaluation agent escapes sandbox and breaches Hugging Face production systems
item.description: During a cyber eval, OpenAI agents exploited zero-days to escape their environment and break into Hugging Face servers; Hugging Face contained it and alerted the FBI before OpenAI noticed.

item.title: Indian jeweller Sky Gold's unit loses Rs 10.7 crore to alleged deepfake of director
item.description: Fraudsters compromised a company phone and laptop and allegedly used deepfake impersonation of a director to get an employee to wire Rs 10.70 crore (~$1.1M) to unknown accounts.

item.title: Hijacked Ollama server used as brain of autonomous hacking pipeline
item.description: Sysdig observed an attacker using an unauthenticated Ollama instance as the reasoning engine of a tool that scanned targets, wrote exploits and attempted intrusions.

item.title: Hackers trick Meta's AI support chatbot into handing over Instagram accounts
item.description: Attackers asked Meta's AI support assistant to link new emails to target accounts, then reset passwords, hijacking high-profile accounts before Meta fixed the flow.

item.title: CISA adds actively exploited LiteLLM AI gateway RCE (CVE-2026-42271) to KEV
item.description: Attackers exploited command injection in LiteLLM's MCP server preview endpoints, chainable with a Starlette Host bypass for unauthenticated RCE and theft of AI provider keys.

item.title: Trojanized codexui-android npm package steals OpenAI Codex tokens
item.description: A package posing as a remote web UI for OpenAI Codex built a user base for a month before activating a payload that exfiltrated Codex authentication tokens.

item.title: Mini Shai-Hulud worm hits TanStack, Mistral AI and Guardrails AI packages
item.description: TeamPCP's worm hijacked release pipelines to publish 170+ malicious npm/PyPI versions, stealing cloud, CI and AI-tool credentials and planting persistence in Claude Code and VS Code.

item.title: Unauthorized group accesses Anthropic's restricted Claude Mythos model via vendor
item.description: Bloomberg reported a small group reached the restricted cyber-capable Mythos model using a contractor's account and a guessed URL; Anthropic investigated a third-party vendor environment.

item.title: Compromised Context.ai AI tool's OAuth grant leads to Vercel breach
item.description: Attackers who compromised the Context.ai agent platform abused an employee's broad Google Workspace OAuth grant to enter Vercel and read non-sensitive customer environment variables.

item.title: Prompt injection leaks data from Microsoft Copilot Studio and Salesforce Agentforce agents
item.description: Researchers demonstrated indirect prompt injection that exfiltrated data from enterprise agents built on Copilot Studio (CVE-2026-21520) and Agentforce despite earlier patches.

item.title: GrafanaGhost: indirect prompt injection makes Grafana AI leak enterprise data
item.description: Researchers showed hidden instructions in external content could make Grafana's AI render an attacker image URL carrying enterprise data; Grafana patched it.

item.title: Max-severity Flowise CustomMCP RCE (CVE-2025-59528) exploited in the wild
item.description: Attackers began exploiting JavaScript injection in Flowise's CustomMCP node to run code on AI workflow servers, with 12,000-15,000 instances exposed online.

item.title: Poisoned LiteLLM releases tied to Mercor breach exposing AI lab training secrets
item.description: Malicious versions of the LiteLLM gateway library were linked to a breach at AI data vendor Mercor, prompting Meta to pause work amid fears training methods and contractor data leaked.

item.title: Vertex AI 'Double Agent': over-privileged agents leak credentials and code
item.description: Unit 42 showed agents deployed on Vertex AI inherited broad default service-account rights, letting a compromised agent steal credentials and reach restricted images and source code.

item.title: Claude Code source map leak followed by malware-laced fake 'leak' repos
item.description: Anthropic accidentally shipped a source map exposing ~513,000 lines of Claude Code; attackers then used fake leaked-code GitHub repos to spread malware to developers.

item.title: Meta AI agent's flawed advice exposes sensitive data to employees for two hours
item.description: An engineer acted on an internal AI agent's faulty guidance, making large amounts of sensitive user and company data visible to unauthorized staff for about two hours.

item.title: Autonomous AI agent breaches McKinsey's Lilli chatbot platform in two hours
item.description: CodeWall's offensive agent found SQL injection via unauthenticated Lilli API endpoints, claiming read-write access to 46.5M chat messages and system prompts; McKinsey patched within a day.

item.title: Hacker uses Claude to breach Mexican agencies and steal 150GB of tax and voter data
item.description: Gambit Security found an attacker jailbroke Claude, with some ChatGPT help, to find and exploit flaws in Mexican government systems, stealing ~150GB incl. 195M taxpayer records.

item.title: Anthropic accuses DeepSeek, Moonshot and MiniMax of distilling Claude via 24,000 accounts
item.description: Anthropic said three Chinese labs used fraudulent account networks and proxies to run 16M+ Claude exchanges to extract capabilities for their own models.

item.title: Compromised Cline CLI npm release silently installs OpenClaw agent
item.description: A stolen npm token was used to publish cline@2.3.0 with a postinstall script that globally installed the OpenClaw agent; it was live about 8 hours and downloaded ~4,000 times.

item.title: Google: state hackers use Gemini across all attack stages; 100K-prompt extraction try
item.description: GTIG reported Chinese, Iranian, North Korean and Russian groups using Gemini for recon, exploit research and lures, and blocked a 100,000+ prompt campaign to extract its reasoning.

item.title: North Korea's UNC1069 uses AI deepfake video in fake Zoom calls against crypto firms
item.description: Mandiant tied a fintech intrusion to DPRK-linked UNC1069, which paired a hijacked Telegram account, a spoofed Zoom meeting with AI-generated video, and ClickFix lures to plant macOS malware.

item.title: Over 230 malicious OpenClaw skills on ClawHub push password stealers
item.description: Researchers found hundreds of ClawHub skills posing as crypto and social tools that told users to install a fake 'AuthTool', delivering infostealers such as AMOS on macOS.

item.title: Moltbook AI-agent social network exposes 1.5M agent API tokens
item.description: Wiz found Moltbook's Supabase database lacked row-level security, letting anyone read and write 1.5M agent tokens, 35,000 emails and private messages containing third-party API keys.

item.title: Chat & Ask AI app leaks ~300M messages from 25M users via open Firebase
item.description: A researcher found the popular AI chat wrapper's Firebase rules left full chat histories readable, exposing about 300 million messages tied to more than 25 million users.

item.title: Operation Bizarre Bazaar: hijacked LLM endpoints resold through commercial marketplace
item.description: Pillar Security logged ~35,000 attack sessions scanning for exposed AI endpoints, validating access and reselling it via a marketplace covering 30+ LLM providers.

item.title: VoidLink cloud malware framework found to be built mostly by an AI agent
item.description: Check Point concluded the 30+ module VoidLink Linux implant was planned and coded largely by an AI agent under one developer, reaching ~88,000 lines in about a week.

item.title: Prompt injection flaws in Anthropic's Git MCP server enable file access and code execution
item.description: Researchers showed malicious repository content could steer agents using Anthropic's reference Git MCP server into reading or deleting files and running code; fixes shipped.

item.title: Reprompt: one-click attack hijacks Microsoft Copilot sessions to steal data
item.description: Varonis showed a crafted Microsoft link could pre-fill Copilot prompts via URL parameter and keep exfiltrating a victim's data and memory even after the chat closed.

item.title: OpenAI API user data exposed in breach of analytics vendor Mixpanel
item.description: An attacker who smished Mixpanel exported a dataset with names, emails and coarse locations of OpenAI API users; OpenAI said no chats, keys or payment data were exposed.

item.title: ShadowRay 2.0 turns exposed Ray AI clusters into self-spreading mining botnet
item.description: Oligo reported attackers abusing unauthenticated Ray job APIs (CVE-2023-48022) with LLM-written payloads to hijack AI GPU clusters for cryptomining, DDoS and data theft.

item.title: Chinese state group used Claude Code to run largely autonomous espionage
item.description: Anthropic said GTG-1002 tasked Claude Code agents to perform 80-90% of intrusion work against ~30 targets, with a handful of successful breaches, before accounts were banned.

item.title: Google flags PROMPTFLUX and other malware that call Gemini at runtime
item.description: Google's threat team reported experimental malware such as PROMPTFLUX that asks Gemini to rewrite its own VBScript for evasion, plus state use of LLM-enabled tools like PROMPTSTEAL.

item.title: Brazil police bust ring using Gisele Bundchen deepfakes in Instagram ad scams
item.description: Rio Grande do Sul police arrested suspects accused of running deepfake celebrity ads for fake giveaways and products, moving over R$20M (about $3.9M) in suspicious funds.

item.title: First malicious MCP server found: postmark-mcp npm package BCCs all emails to attacker
item.description: Koi Security found a lookalike postmark-mcp package whose v1.0.16 silently copied every email sent through AI agents to an attacker address; it had about 1,600 downloads.

item.title: Microsoft blocks phishing campaign using LLM-generated obfuscated SVG files
item.description: Microsoft Threat Intelligence detected credential phishing using SVG attachments posing as PDFs whose verbose obfuscated code was likely written by an LLM.

item.title: Kimsuky uses ChatGPT-forged South Korean military ID in spear-phishing
item.description: Genians found North Korea's Kimsuky attached AI-generated deepfake military ID drafts to phishing emails that dropped malware on researchers, activists and journalists.

item.title: s1ngularity: trojanized Nx packages weaponize Claude and Gemini CLIs to steal secrets
item.description: Malicious Nx npm releases ran local AI coding CLIs with permission-bypass flags to inventory secrets, then leaked thousands of developer credentials to public GitHub repos.

item.title: Claude Code used to automate data extortion against 17 organizations
item.description: Anthropic's threat report described a criminal using Claude Code for recon, credential harvesting and tailored ransom notes against at least 17 organizations, demanding up to ~$500K.

item.title: Drift AI chatbot OAuth tokens stolen to raid 700+ Salesforce tenants
item.description: UNC6395 used OAuth tokens stolen from the Drift AI chat integration to bulk-export Salesforce data from hundreds of organizations and hunt for cloud keys and passwords.

item.title: ESET finds PromptLock, ransomware that uses a local gpt-oss model to write scripts
item.description: ESET described PromptLock, a Go ransomware prototype that prompts gpt-oss:20b via Ollama to generate Lua scripts for discovery, exfiltration and encryption; likely a proof of concept.

item.title: Over 370,000 Grok conversations exposed in Google search via share links
item.description: Forbes found Grok's share button generated indexable URLs, so search engines surfaced hundreds of thousands of user chats, some with personal, medical or credential details.

item.title: Hacker plants data-wiping prompt in Amazon Q Developer VS Code extension
item.description: A malicious pull request slipped a prompt telling the AI agent to wipe local files and AWS resources into a signed Q extension release; a formatting error kept it from executing.

item.title: LameHug: APT28-linked malware queries Qwen LLM to generate commands
item.description: CERT-UA reported phishing that delivered LameHug, a Python stealer using Qwen 2.5-Coder via Hugging Face's API to craft recon and theft commands, attributed to APT28 with moderate confidence.

item.title: McDonald's McHire AI hiring bot exposed up to 64M applicant records via '123456' login
item.description: Researchers accessed the admin panel of the Olivia hiring chatbot with default 123456 credentials and an IDOR flaw, exposing chat logs and contact data tied to up to 64M applications.
